event.title: Trump Issues Threats Against Iranian Infrastructure Amid Strait of Hormuz Tensions
event.canonical_title: Trump Issues Threats Against Iranian Infrastructure Amid Strait of Hormuz Tensions
event.summary: US President Donald Trump has threatened to target Iranian bridges and power plants in retaliation for any attacks on ships in the Strait of Hormuz. He stated that for each ship fired upon by Iranian forces, the US would respond by destroying a corresponding piece of Iranian infrastructure. This escalation comes amid ongoing tensions in the region and rising oil prices.

event_overview.title: About Iran War
event_overview.subject: Iran War
event_overview.summary: The Iran War is the 2026 armed conflict involving the United States, Iran and Israel, centered on attacks, counterattacks and threats affecting Iran, neighboring states and maritime traffic in and around the Persian Gulf and Strait of Hormuz. U.S. officials said combat operations began on February 28, 2026, citing self-defense, protection of regional forces and allies, and freedom of maritime commerce; the United Nations has called for de-escalation, protection of civilians and compliance with international law.

facts.label: Start and parties
facts.value: The conflict’s current phase began on February 28, 2026. The United States notified the UN that it had commenced combat operations against Iran in cooperation with Israel; the UN Secretary-General also described subsequent Iranian attacks affecting Bahrain, Iraq, Jordan, Kuwait, Qatar, Saudi Arabia and the United Arab Emirates.

facts.label: Geographic focus
facts.value: The Strait of Hormuz—between Iran and Oman, linking the Persian Gulf with the Gulf of Oman and Arabian Sea—is a central theater because its security directly affects regional shipping and energy exports.

facts.label: Maritime and energy stakes
facts.value: Disruption to shipping through Hormuz has been a major international consequence: EIA reported that military action and the resulting de facto closure sharply reduced oil flows and contributed to large price increases in early 2026.

facts.label: Diplomatic and legal framework
facts.value: The UN has urged an immediate cessation of hostilities and stated that all parties must uphold the UN Charter, protect civilians under international humanitarian law and preserve nuclear safety. In the United States, the War Powers Resolution requires presidential consultation with Congress where possible and a written report within 48 hours when U.S. forces are introduced into hostilities without a declaration of wa

facts.label: Broader policy context
facts.value: The conflict occurs alongside longstanding international concern over Iran’s nuclear programme. UN Security Council Resolution 2231, adopted in 2015 to endorse the JCPOA, remains part of that background; the UN says earlier Iran-related Security Council measures were re-applied on September 27, 2025.

event_overview.scope_note: The selected Muninn timeline focuses on late-July 2026 escalation, congressional war-powers action, Houthi-linked regional attacks, oil-market effects and ceasefire diplomacy; it does not attempt to document the conflict’s full military, humanitarian, diplomatic or legal history.
